propositions: When a ticket description exceeds the configured cap (verify.max_ticket_description_chars, default 8000) and the plan-review claim gate is enabled, a save-time warning must be emitted at create or edit time, stating the description length, the cap, and that the claim gate will refuse admission until shortened.
The save-time warning must be computed after the ticket write succeeds and must never block or alter the write; it degrades to None on any error.
The warning must be surfaced across all three ticket-write channels: CLI stderr, library rebar logger, and MCP result fields (CreateResultOut.description_warning, WriteAckOut.description_warning).
The save-time warning and the plan-review admission guard must read the same config key (verify.max_ticket_description_chars) to preserve single-sourcing and ensure consistency.
No warning is emitted when the gate is disabled, the description is within cap, or the ticket type is exempt from plan review.

The config key and its default (8000 characters) must be documented in docs/config.md; the implementation must pass lint, typecheck, and comprehensive unit tests covering all surfaces and gate states.
